title: Wings Like the Eagles
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler of courage, and tonight is about the bravest kind of waiting: Isaiah's worn-out people wait on the Lord for strength they do not have yet, and Beau, legs aching on the long walk home, takes three slow breaths, holds his dad's hand, and finds one more step.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because waiting for strength you do not have yet takes real courage. In Beau's world today: the walk home from the park is long and his legs ache. He wants to be carried. He takes three slow breaths, holds his dad's hand, and finds one more step, and then one more. Just like the tired people who waited on the Lord and rose up like eagles, Beau learned that new strength comes to the ones who wait.
